_why: S08 4Seconds Everyday: the build used CH_P_EVE_50_TypeB (dark burgundy shirt / black skirt, texture means 0.13/0.06/0.06); the original photo = white blouse, silver fittings = base CH_P_EVE_50 set (shirt texture mean 0.61). Both GLBs have identical primitives (vertex counts per material equal) -> same frozen mesh, textures / layer data taken from the base material instances. GlowEmissive (no parameters in SB json, built dark flat) -> orange glow (neck gem, shoulder points in the photo).
